title: Two Idli Batters Side by Side
description: A two-row ratio table for idli batter. Viswanath's row 6 cups rice, 3 cups dal is divided by 3 to give 2 : 1; Puneet's row 4 cups rice, 2 cups dal is divided by 2 to give 2 : 1. A bracket marks the two results as the same ratio.

title: Map Scale: Straight Line, Road and Scale Bar
description: A generic outline map with two towns A and B joined by a straight dashed line 2 cm long and by a winding road. A scale bar of the same length, marked 0, 60 km and 120 km, sits below with RF 1 : 60,00,000 under it. The dashed line is labelled geographical distance.

topic_name: Ratios with More than Two Terms
title: Two Spice Mixes Compared
description: A ratio table: Viswanath 8, 4, 2, 1 and Puneet 4, 2, 1, 0.5 under coriander, chillies, toor dal and fenugreek, with a ×0.5 arrow down each column.

topic_name: Ratios with More than Two Terms
title: Purple paint bar: 10 equal parts, white is 10 litres
description: A bar of 10 equal parts, 2 red, 3 blue and 5 white; the 5 white parts are bracketed as 10 litres, and each part reads 2 litres.

topic_name: Dividing a Whole in a Given Ratio
title: 110 units of concrete split in the ratio 1 : 1.5 : 3
description: A pile of 110 units of concrete splits along three arrows marked 1, 1.5 and 3 into 20 units of cement, 30 units of sand and 60 units of gravel.

topic_name: Dividing a Whole in a Given Ratio
title: A Triangle Built from 1 : 3 : 5
description: Triangle ABC with angles of 20° at A, 60° at B and 100° at C, beside a bar of 180° split into 9 equal parts of 20° and grouped as 1, 3 and 5 parts in colours that match the angle arcs.

title: Halving Every Term Keeps Every Share
description: Two equal-length bars stacked: the upper one split into 40 cells as 12, 10, 8, 6 and 4 for grades A to E, the lower one split into cells twice as wide as 6, 5, 4, 3 and 2. Every boundary lines up, and a ÷2 arrow joins each pair of segments.

title: The Finished Grade Pie Chart
description: A flat pie chart with five slices anti-clockwise from a radius pointing right: grade A 108° (12 students), grade B 90° (10), grade C 72° (8), grade D 54° (6) and grade E 36° (4), each coloured and labelled.

title: Speed Up, Time Down: The Product Stays 90
description: A speed-time table for one fixed journey: walk, bicycle, motorcycle and car at 5, 15, 30 and 60 km/h take 18, 6, 3 and 1.5 hours. Arrows ×3, ×2, ×2 run along the speed row and ÷3, ÷2, ÷2 along the time row, and 90 sits under every column.

title: Same road, same work: 20 × 4 and 10 × 8 worker-days
description: Two grids of small squares with equal area. The left grid is 20 squares wide (workers) and 4 squares tall (days). The right grid is 10 squares wide and 8 squares tall. Both hold 80 squares, labelled 80 worker-days. Arrows show the workers divided by 2 and the days multiplied by 2.

title: Work in one hour: Ram, Shyam and both together
description: Top panel: two bars of equal cells show the work done in one hour, Ram 1 unit (3 cells) and Shyam 2/3 unit (2 cells). Bottom panel, set apart by a gap: the Together bar, 5/3 units (5 cells), with a time line from 0 to 1 hour attached under it. The first 3 cells of the Together bar, one whole unit, line up with 3/5 hour on that time line.
